95	
96	Edit mode ("Edit" in the top bar, nothing installed): the consultant notes and the reference panel become editable plain text — add or delete list items, add notes to an activity without them, delete a source — and so do the views: card title, value-table cells (rows added or deleted) and the change-history rows. 97	</Document_Contents>
98	
99	<Checks>
100	Built-in: activities whose values could not be read. 101	</Checks>

104	- `scripts/config/extract-config.mjs` — IMG walk, values, transports, docs → `config-docs/<M>/snapshot.json`
105	- `scripts/config/sap-reader.mjs` — MCP client, SELECT * reads, IN-list chunking, read cache
106	- `scripts/config/itf.mjs` — SAP documentation (ITF) → blocks
107	- `scripts/config/notes.mjs` — note and term batches, marker-text parsing, merge of drafts / reviews / revisions, knowledge base (`kb`), source-cache seeding (`sources`)
108	- `scripts/config/notes-sources.mjs` — verified-source cache `~/.sc4sap/kb/config/<M>/sources-<lang>.json` (status, record, hints)
109	- `scripts/config/notes-lint.mjs` — mechanical batch checks before review; t-code cache `~/.sc4sap/kb/tcodes/<system>.json`
110	- `scripts/config/config-checks.mjs` — rule engine
111	- `scripts/config/build-config-doc.mjs` + `config-doc-page.mjs` — model, screen drawings, page, `--import` of edits
112	- `scripts/config/config-doc-editor.mjs` — edit mode (styles, client script, labels)
113	</Files>

# SuperClaude for SAP (sc4sap) — Development Rules

This file is the **index** of development rules — NOT a payload to preload. Detailed rules live in `common/` and `exceptions/`. Consult files on demand per [`common/context-loading-protocol.md`](common/context-loading-protocol.md) — 4-tier model: **Tier 1** global mandatory safety baseline (always loaded by every agent: `data-extraction-policy`, `sap-version-reference`, `naming-conventions`; `context-loading-protocol` + `model-routing-rule` are orchestrator-only, read by skills), **Tier 2** role-mandatory per agent group, **Tier 3** triggered reads, **Tier 4** per-task kit. Everything referenced below is MANDATORY for every sc4sap session (agents, skills, direct user requests, pipelines).

## Development Standards — References

| Topic | Reference |
|---|---|
| Naming conventions (Z/Y prefixes, module prefix, includes, FGs, tables, DEs, DOs) | [`common/naming-conventions.md`](common/naming-conventions.md) |
| Field typing priority (Standard DE → CBO DE → new CBO DE → Data Type+Length; never `LIFNR CHAR 10`) | [`common/field-typing-rule.md`](common/field-typing-rule.md) |
| Function Module source convention (inline IMPORTING/EXPORTING/TABLES in FUNCTION statement; no placeholder, no shadow locals) | [`common/function-module-rule.md`](common/function-module-rule.md) |
| SAP version awareness (ECC vs S/4HANA — tables, TCodes, BAPIs, patterns) | [`common/sap-version-reference.md`](common/sap-version-reference.md) |
| ABAP release awareness (syntax availability per release, never emit newer features than `ABAP_RELEASE`) | [`common/abap-release-reference.md`](common/abap-release-reference.md) |
| Clean ABAP coding standards (paradigm-split) | shared baseline [`common/clean-code.md`](common/clean-code.md) + one of [`common/clean-code-oop.md`](common/clean-code-oop.md) or [`common/clean-code-procedural.md`](common/clean-code-procedural.md) chosen from the Phase 1B Paradigm dimension; also pulls in `constant-rule.md`, `text-element-rule.md`, `abap-release-reference.md` |
| Procedural FORM naming (screen-bound suffix) | [`common/procedural-form-naming.md`](common/procedural-form-naming.md) |
| OOP two-class split pattern | [`common/oop-pattern.md`](common/oop-pattern.md) |
| Include structure (Main + conditional includes) | [`common/include-structure.md`](common/include-structure.md) |
| ALV display rules | [`common/alv-rules.md`](common/alv-rules.md) |
| Tabstrip screens (STRIP_CTRL + subscreen area + tab PUSH rows, `CALL SUBSCREEN` in PBO and PAI) | [`common/screen-tabstrip.md`](common/screen-tabstrip.md) |
| OK_CODE binding pattern (one TOP variable + screen NAME + PAI dispatch; never `CASE sy-ucomm`) | [`common/ok-code-pattern.md`](common/ok-code-pattern.md) |
| SPRO lookup protocol (consultant agents, IMG/Customizing) | [`common/spro-lookup.md`](common/spro-lookup.md) |
| Customization lookup protocol (existing Z*/Y* BAdI impl, CMOD, form-exits, appends — mandatory before recommending new enhancements/extensions) | [`common/customization-lookup.md`](common/customization-lookup.md) |
| Data extraction policy (blocklist rule, `acknowledge_risk` hard rule, refusal template) | [`common/data-extraction-policy.md`](common/data-extraction-policy.md) |
| Transport client rule (every `CreateTransport` must receive explicit `client` from `.sc4sap/sap.env` SAP_CLIENT — never an implicit default) | [`common/transport-client-rule.md`](common/transport-client-rule.md) |
| Blocklist (per-category table lists) | [`exceptions/table_exception.md`](exceptions/table_exception.md) (index) + `exceptions/*.md` section files |
| Industry business-context references (14 industries) | [`industry/README.md`](industry/README.md) + `industry/*.md` |
| Country / localization references (16 countries + EU common) | [`country/README.md`](country/README.md) + `country/*.md` |
| Active modules — cross-module integration matrix (MM↔PS, SD↔CO, QM↔PP, …) | [`common/active-modules.md`](common/active-modules.md) |
| Context loading protocol (CLAUDE.md is an index; every dispatch declares its minimal context kit) | [`common/context-loading-protocol.md`](common/context-loading-protocol.md) |
| Model routing (Opus for judgment / novel code; Sonnet for template + bulk writes; Haiku `sap-checker` fan-out for fetch / verify / detect) | [`common/model-routing-rule.md`](common/model-routing-rule.md) |
| Model dispatch mode (`auto` default = route per rule; `user-defined` = ask Opus / Sonnet / Haiku before each dispatch group; set via `/sc4sap:sap-option`) | [`common/model-dispatch-mode.md`](common/model-dispatch-mode.md) |

Before any work: verify `.sc4sap/config.json` exists and contains `sapVersion`, `abapRelease`, `industry`. Every recommendation, piece of generated code, and tool invocation must respect those fields.

## Critical Rules (summary — full text in referenced files)

1. **Custom objects use `Z`/`Y` prefix.** Full rules: `common/naming-conventions.md`.
2. **Match SAP version and ABAP release.** Never use S/4-only tables on ECC or syntax newer than the configured `abapRelease`. Full rules: `common/sap-version-reference.md`, `common/abap-release-reference.md`.
3. **Transport discipline.** Every change goes on a transport. Description format: `[MODULE] [Action] [Object] - [brief]`. Never release with syntax errors or inactive objects. Every `CreateTransport` call must receive an explicit `client` parameter resolved from `.sc4sap/sap.env` SAP_CLIENT (full rule: `common/transport-client-rule.md`).
4. **Activate after every change.** Run `GetAbapSemanticAnalysis` for syntax, then `GetInactiveObjects` to confirm no leftovers. Follow Clean ABAP conventions: `common/clean-code.md` (shared) + the paradigm-specific companion (`clean-code-oop.md` OR `clean-code-procedural.md`).
5. **Data extraction is gated.** Before any `GetTableContents` / `GetSqlQuery`: consult `exceptions/table_exception.md` and `common/data-extraction-policy.md`. Schema/DDIC (`GetTable`, `GetStructure`, `GetView`, `GetDataElement`, `GetDomain`) is always allowed.
6. **`acknowledge_risk` requires explicit user affirmative** (`yes` / `승인` / `authorize` / `approve` / `proceed` / `confirmed`). Ambiguous commands (`뽑아봐`, `try it`, `pull it`, `my mistake`) are NOT authorization. Per-call, per-table, per-session — never carries over. Full protocol: `common/data-extraction-policy.md` → "The `acknowledge_risk` Parameter — HARD RULE".
7. **Industry context matters.** For config analysis / business process design / Fit-Gap: load the project's `industry/<key>.md` (from `config.json` → `industry` or `sap.env` → `SAP_INDUSTRY`). If unset, ask the user.
8. **Country / localization context matters.** For tax, e-invoicing, banking, statutory reporting, date/number formats: load the project's `country/<iso>.md` (from `config.json` → `country` or `sap.env` → `SAP_COUNTRY`, ISO alpha-2 lowercase: `kr`, `us`, `de`, `eu-common`, …). Multi-country projects load every relevant file and flag cross-country touchpoints (intercompany, intra-EU VAT, transfer pricing). If unset, ask the user.

Enforcement: L1 agent instructions → L2 this file → L3 `PreToolUse` hook (`scripts/hooks/block-forbidden-tables.mjs`) → L4 MCP server upstream guard.

## Plugin Usage

### Skills (`/sc4sap:` prefix)
- `/sc4sap:setup` — Initial plugin setup + SPRO config generation (auto-invokes `trust-session`)
- `/sc4sap:create-program` — Full ABAP program pipeline (Phase 0–8) with execution-mode gate (auto/manual/hybrid) and parallel Phase 4/6; auto-invokes `trust-session` at Phase 1
- `/sc4sap:create-object` — Single ABAP object creation (auto-invokes `trust-session`)
- `/sc4sap:program-to-spec` — Reverse-engineer a program into a spec artifact
- `/sc4sap:program-to-manual` — End-user manual for one program: one HTML file, scenario steps on drawn screens with numbered callouts, check points, field reference, messages & actions, glossary, revision history; one step per A4 landscape page in print. Output `.sc4sap/manuals/<PROGRAM>-v<n>-<lang>.html` (auto-invokes `trust-session`)
- `/sc4sap:analyze-code` — Static code review (auto-invokes `trust-session`)
- `/sc4sap:compare-programs` — Business-angle side-by-side comparison of 2–5 ABAP programs sharing the same scenario but differing by module / country / persona (reader = consultant) → one editable, versioned HTML report (verdict matrix + *Differences only*, field differences, screens side by side, decision guide, English companion) `comparisons/<NAME>-v<n>-<lang>.html` under the profile artifact base (auto-invokes `trust-session`)
- `/sc4sap:config-to-document` — One module's configuration documented from the live system: IMG tree, per IMG activity the real table values drawn on an SM30-style screen, customer-changed rows with their transports, configuration checks, SAP IMG documentation, consultant notes written by the module consultant agent and reviewed by `sap-critic` → one HTML file `config-docs/<MODULE>/<MODULE>-config-v<n>-<lang>.html` under the profile artifact base. MM first.
- `/sc4sap:analyze-symptom` — Dump/error root-cause analysis (auto-invokes `trust-session`)
- `/sc4sap:analyze-cbo-obj` — Inventory a CBO package → save frequently-used Z objects to `.sc4sap/cbo/<MODULE>/<PACKAGE>/` for reuse by `create-program` / `program-to-spec` (auto-invokes `trust-session`)
- `/sc4sap:package-to-process` — Reverse-engineer a CBO package into an End-to-End Business Process document (Markdown): auto-detected TCode entry points → AI process grouping (PR→PO→GR→IR style) → per-process narrative + Mermaid flowchart + sequenceDiagram + step tables. Auto-chains `sap-stocker` if CBO inventory missing. Progress bar at each step. Output: `processes/<MODULE>/<PACKAGE>/process-<YYYYMMDD>-<lang>.md` under the profile-resolved artifact base (`common/multi-profile-artifact-resolution.md`), with `_state/` checkpoints for resume (auto-invokes `trust-session`)
- `/sc4sap:ask-consultant` — Direct user-facing Q&A with a module consultant agent (SD/MM/FI/CO/PP/PS/PM/QM/TR/HCM/WM/TM/BW/Ariba/BC). Auto-routes by keywords, answers against the configured SAP environment. Read-only (no writes, no row extraction).
- `/sc4sap:mcp-setup` — MCP ABAP ADT server configuration guide
- `/sc4sap:sap-option` — View and edit `.sc4sap/sap.env` (credentials, industry, blocklist profile, HUD limits)
- `/sc4sap:sap-doctor` — Diagnose plugin / MCP / SAP connection health
- `/sc4sap:trust-session` — INTERNAL-ONLY — session-wide MCP permission bootstrap; direct invocation is rejected

### Agents
- Core: `sap-analyst`, `sap-architect`, `sap-code-reviewer`, `sap-critic`, `sap-debugger`, `sap-doc-specialist`, `sap-executor`, `sap-planner`, `sap-qa-tester`, `sap-writer`
- Checker: `sap-checker` — Haiku, read-only fan-out worker (`scout` / `verify` / `detect`) that returns structured lines; the main thread dispatches N of them and one Opus agent consumes the result. Used by `/sc4sap:create-program` Phase 1A scout, Phase 4 verification, Phase 6 `detect-judge`; `/sc4sap:analyze-code` size scout, large-object detect-judge, evidence verify; `/sc4sap:compare-programs` facts extraction; `/sc4sap:analyze-cbo-obj` + `/sc4sap:package-to-process` stocking scouts.
- Discovery: `sap-stocker` — CBO inventory / where-used graph / reusable object cataloging (Sonnet, R/O SAP + R/W on `.sc4sap/cbo/`). Consumed by `/sc4sap:analyze-cbo-obj`, `/sc4sap:create-program` (CBO reuse gate), and module consultants via their `<CBO_Stocking_Delegation>` block.
- Basis: `sap-bc-consultant`
- Module consultants: `sap-sd-`, `sap-mm-`, `sap-pp-`, `sap-pm-`, `sap-qm-`, `sap-wm-`, `sap-tm-`, `sap-tr-`, `sap-fi-`, `sap-co-`, `sap-hcm-`, `sap-bw-`, `sap-ps-`, `sap-ariba-consultant`

### SPRO Config Reference
`configs/{MODULE}/` contains `spro.md`, `tcodes.md`, `bapi.md`, `tables.md`, `enhancements.md`, `workflows.md` per module. Consultant agents consult these + `common/spro-lookup.md` before IMG answers.

### MCP Server (mcp-abap-adt)
All SAP interactions go through the MCP ABAP ADT server (150+ tools):
- CRUD: `CreateClass` / `UpdateClass` / `GetClass` / `DeleteClass` (and every DDIC/runtime object type)
- Analysis: `GetAbapAST`, `GetAbapSemanticAnalysis`, `GetWhereUsed`
- Runtime: `RunUnitTest`, `GetUnitTestResult`, `RuntimeAnalyzeDump`
- System: `GetTableContents`, `GetSqlQuery` (gated — see rule 5/6 above)
- Transport: `CreateTransport`, `GetTransport`, `ListTransports`

1. **Custom objects use `Z`/`Y` prefix.** Full rules: `common/naming-conventions.md`.
2. **Match SAP version and ABAP release.** Never use S/4-only tables on ECC or syntax newer than the configured `abapRelease`. Full rules: `common/sap-version-reference.md`, `common/abap-release-reference.md`.
3. **Transport discipline.** Every change goes on a transport. Description format: `[MODULE] [Action] [Object] - [brief]`. Never release with syntax errors or inactive objects. Every `CreateTransport` call must receive an explicit `client` parameter resolved from `.sc4sap/sap.env` SAP_CLIENT (full rule: `common/transport-client-rule.md`).
4. **Activate after every change.** Run `GetAbapSemanticAnalysis` for syntax, then `GetInactiveObjects` to confirm no leftovers. Follow Clean ABAP conventions: `common/clean-code.md` (shared) + the paradigm-specific companion (`clean-code-oop.md` OR `clean-code-procedural.md`).
5. **Data extraction is gated.** Before any `GetTableContents` / `GetSqlQuery`: consult `exceptions/table_exception.md` and `common/data-extraction-policy.md`. Schema/DDIC (`GetTable`, `GetStructure`, `GetView`, `GetDataElement`, `GetDomain`) is always allowed.
6. **`acknowledge_risk` requires explicit user affirmative** (`yes` / `승인` / `authorize` / `approve` / `proceed` / `confirmed`). Ambiguous commands (`뽑아봐`, `try it`, `pull it`, `my mistake`) are NOT authorization. Per-call, per-table, per-session — never carries over. Full protocol: `common/data-extraction-policy.md` → "The `acknowledge_risk` Parameter — HARD RULE".
7. **Industry context matters.** For config analysis / business process design / Fit-Gap: load the project's `industry/<key>.md` (from `config.json` → `industry` or `sap.env` → `SAP_INDUSTRY`). If unset, ask the user.
8. **Country / localization context matters.** For tax, e-invoicing, banking, statutory reporting, date/number formats: load the project's `country/<iso>.md` (from `config.json` → `country` or `sap.env` → `SAP_COUNTRY`, ISO alpha-2 lowercase: `kr`, `us`, `de`, `eu-common`, …). Multi-country projects load every relevant file and flag cross-country touchpoints (intercompany, intra-EU VAT, transfer pricing). If unset, ask the user.

Enforcement: L1 agent instructions → L2 this file → L3 `PreToolUse` hook (`scripts/hooks/block-forbidden-tables.mjs`) → L4 MCP server upstream guard.

## Plugin Usage

### Skills (`/sc4sap:` prefix)
- `/sc4sap:setup` — Initial plugin setup + SPRO config generation (auto-invokes `trust-session`)
- `/sc4sap:create-program` — Full ABAP program pipeline (Phase 0–8) with execution-mode gate (auto/manual/hybrid) and parallel Phase 4/6; auto-invokes `trust-session` at Phase 1
- `/sc4sap:create-object` — Single ABAP object creation (auto-invokes `trust-session`)
- `/sc4sap:program-to-spec` — Reverse-engineer a program into a spec artifact
- `/sc4sap:program-to-manual` — End-user manual for one program: one HTML file, scenario steps on drawn screens with numbered callouts, check points, field reference, messages & actions, glossary, revision history; one step per A4 landscape page in print. Output `.sc4sap/manuals/<PROGRAM>-v<n>-<lang>.html` (auto-invokes `trust-session`)
- `/sc4sap:analyze-code` — Static code review (auto-invokes `trust-session`)
- `/sc4sap:compare-programs` — Business-angle side-by-side comparison of 2–5 ABAP programs sharing the same scenario but differing by module / country / persona (reader = consultant) → one editable, versioned HTML report (verdict matrix + *Differences only*, field differences, screens side by side, decision guide, English companion) `comparisons/<NAME>-v<n>-<lang>.html` under the profile artifact base (auto-invokes `trust-session`)
- `/sc4sap:config-to-document` — One module's configuration documented from the live system: IMG tree, per IMG activity the real table values drawn on an SM30-style screen, customer-changed rows with their transports, configuration checks, SAP IMG documentation, consultant notes written by the module consultant agent and reviewed by `sap-critic` → one HTML file `config-docs/<MODULE>/<MODULE>-config-v<n>-<lang>.html` under the profile artifact base. MM first.
- `/sc4sap:analyze-symptom` — Dump/error root-cause analysis (auto-invokes `trust-session`)
- `/sc4sap:analyze-cbo-obj` — Inventory a CBO package → save frequently-used Z objects to `.sc4sap/cbo/<MODULE>/<PACKAGE>/` for reuse by `create-program` / `program-to-spec` (auto-invokes `trust-session`)
- `/sc4sap:package-to-process` — Reverse-engineer a CBO package into an End-to-End Business Process document (Markdown): auto-detected TCode entry points → AI process grouping (PR→PO→GR→IR style) → per-process narrative + Mermaid flowchart + sequenceDiagram + step tables. Auto-chains `sap-stocker` if CBO inventory missing. Progress bar at each step. Output: `processes/<MODULE>/<PACKAGE>/process-<YYYYMMDD>-<lang>.md` under the profile-resolved artifact base (`common/multi-profile-artifact-resolution.md`), with `_state/` checkpoints for resume (auto-invokes `trust-session`)
- `/sc4sap:ask-consultant` — Direct user-facing Q&A with a module consultant agent (SD/MM/FI/CO/PP/PS/PM/QM/TR/HCM/WM/TM/BW/Ariba/BC). Auto-routes by keywords, answers against the configured SAP environment. Read-only (no writes, no row extraction).
- `/sc4sap:mcp-setup` — MCP ABAP ADT server configuration guide
- `/sc4sap:sap-option` — View and edit `.sc4sap/sap.env` (credentials, industry, blocklist profile, HUD limits)
- `/sc4sap:sap-doctor` — Diagnose plugin / MCP / SAP connection health
- `/sc4sap:trust-session` — INTERNAL-ONLY — session-wide MCP permission bootstrap; direct invocation is rejected

### Agents
- Core: `sap-analyst`, `sap-architect`, `sap-code-reviewer`, `sap-critic`, `sap-debugger`, `sap-doc-specialist`, `sap-executor`, `sap-planner`, `sap-qa-tester`, `sap-writer`
- Checker: `sap-checker` — Haiku, read-only fan-out worker (`scout` / `verify` / `detect`) that returns structured lines; the main thread dispatches N of them and one Opus agent consumes the result. Used by `/sc4sap:create-program` Phase 1A scout, Phase 4 verification, Phase 6 `detect-judge`; `/sc4sap:analyze-code` size scout, large-object detect-judge, evidence verify; `/sc4sap:compare-programs` facts extraction; `/sc4sap:analyze-cbo-obj` + `/sc4sap:package-to-process` stocking scouts.
- Discovery: `sap-stocker` — CBO inventory / where-used graph / reusable object cataloging (Sonnet, R/O SAP + R/W on `.sc4sap/cbo/`). Consumed by `/sc4sap:analyze-cbo-obj`, `/sc4sap:create-program` (CBO reuse gate), and module consultants via their `<CBO_Stocking_Delegation>` block.
- Basis: `sap-bc-consultant`
- Module consultants: `sap-sd-`, `sap-mm-`, `sap-pp-`, `sap-pm-`, `sap-qm-`, `sap-wm-`, `sap-tm-`, `sap-tr-`, `sap-fi-`, `sap-co-`, `sap-hcm-`, `sap-bw-`, `sap-ps-`, `sap-ariba-consultant`

### SPRO Config Reference
`configs/{MODULE}/` contains `spro.md`, `tcodes.md`, `bapi.md`, `tables.md`, `enhancements.md`, `workflows.md` per module. Consultant agents consult these + `common/spro-lookup.md` before IMG answers.

### MCP Server (mcp-abap-adt)
All SAP interactions go through the MCP ABAP ADT server (150+ tools):
- CRUD: `CreateClass` / `UpdateClass` / `GetClass` / `DeleteClass` (and every DDIC/runtime object type)
- Analysis: `GetAbapAST`, `GetAbapSemanticAnalysis`, `GetWhereUsed`
- Runtime: `RunUnitTest`, `GetUnitTestResult`, `RuntimeAnalyzeDump`
- System: `GetTableContents`, `GetSqlQuery` (gated — see rule 5/6 above)
- Transport: `CreateTransport`, `GetTransport`, `ListTransports`

</system-reminder>

10	
11	<Purpose>
12	Consultants, key users and auditors need to know how a system is set up — not how SAP describes the module in general. This skill answers "what is configured here, what did the project change, and what looks wrong" from the system itself. GUI screenshots are not possible, so the screens are drawn with the shared screen renderer (the same drawing as `program-to-manual`), filled with the values read from the tables.
13	</Purpose>
14	
15	<Response_Prefix>Every response triggered by this skill MUST begin with `[Model: <main-model> · Dispatched: <sub-summary>]` per [`../../common/model-routing-rule.md`](../../common/model-routing-rule.md) § Response Prefix Convention.</Response_Prefix>

20	- "설정 문서", "컨피그 리스트", "configuration list", "IMG 설정 정리", "SPRO 설정 문서화", "설정 점검", "config audit", "how is MM configured in this system"
21	- Go-live / handover / audit: the configuration must be written down as it is
22	- Before a rollout or a system copy: what did the project change in the IMG
23	</Use_When>

25	<Do_Not_Use_When>
26	- One program's behaviour → `/sc4sap:program-to-spec` or `/sc4sap:program-to-manual`
27	- A question about one setting → `/sc4sap:ask-consultant` (answers in chat)
28	- Business-process documentation of a custom package → `/sc4sap:package-to-process`
29	</Do_Not_Use_When>

31	<Decisions_Fixed>
32	Settled when the skill was designed — do not ask again:
33	- **Real values, as they are.** The document shows the table values exactly as read (organisation names included). It is an internal document; say so once in the closing message.
34	- **Read-only.** Only customizing / system tables (delivery class C, G, E, S), DDIC metadata and the transport key tables are read — on ECC through `ZMCP_ADT_DISPATCH` `TABLE_READ`, which refuses everything else. The MCP blocklist still applies; a refused table shows as "Not readable" in the document, never as a failure.
35	- **Customer change = customer transport.** A row counts as customer-changed when a non-SAP transport (`E071K`, `TRKORR NOT LIKE 'SAP%'`) recorded its key, in any client.
36	- **Language.** Texts (IMG titles, field labels, value texts) in the document language when the system has them, else English. SAP documentation is mostly English.
37	- **One file.** HTML with data and drawings embedded; works offline; prints.

41	- Module (required): `MM` today. `SD`, `PP`, `PM`, `QM`, `LE`, `PS`, `CO` resolve through the same IMG walk (`--module X`); only MM has check rules (`configs/MM/config-checks.json`) yet — other modules get the built-in checks.
42	- Areas (optional): IMG areas under the module node — default all.

46	<Workflow>
47	
48	**Step 1 — Module and preflight.** Take the module from the arguments; if missing, ask with `AskUserQuestion` (MM first, recommended). Confirm the active profile (`.sc4sap/active-profile.txt`) in one line.
49	
50	**Step 2 — Areas.** Run
51	```
52	node scripts/config/extract-config.mjs --module <M> --list-areas
53	```
54	Show the areas (document language + English) and ask with one `AskUserQuestion` (`multiSelect: true`, first option "All areas (Recommended)"). A full MM run reads about 1,300 tables (15–25 minutes on ECC); say so when the user picks all.
55	
56	If the command fails with `TABLE_READ: table … is not allowed` on an IMG table (`TNODEIMG`, `CUS_IMGACH`), the system's `ZMCP_ADT_DISPATCH` predates the customizing allow rule: stop and tell the user to update it from `abap/zmcp_adt_dispatch_ecc.abap` (setup Step 9) — never work around the dispatcher.
57	
58	**Step 3 — Extract.** Run in the background (`run_in_background: true`):
59	```
60	node scripts/config/extract-config.mjs --module <M> [--areas "<Area 1>,<Area 2>"] [--lang <lang>]
61	```
62	It prints progress (`tables n/N`) on stderr and one JSON line at the end: `{ ok, file, counts }`. An interrupted run resumes from its read cache; `--fresh` starts over (use it when the user asks for a refresh of an earlier document). Report the counts when it finishes.
63	
64	**Step 4 — Consultant notes and reference material (written, then reviewed).** Per IMG activity the notes card (purpose, effect of *this system's* values, cautions, references) and the reference panel (SAP documentation summarised in the document language, 2–3 setup cases with flow diagrams and which one this system follows, comparison table, decision checklist, decision criteria, official SAP sources — Help Portal, Notes / KBAs, Learning — opened and cited) are written by the module consultant agent and reviewed by `sap-critic`; never by the main thread. Prompts: [`notes-prompts.md`](notes-prompts.md) — use them verbatim with the placeholders filled.
65	0. **Terms first.** `node scripts/config/notes.mjs terms --module <M>` → `terms/_in/tNNN.json` (names SAP has no document-language text for: IMG folders, activity titles, field labels; 150 per batch; translated terms are reused by later runs). Per batch: writer then reviewer, prompt § 4. Skip when it reports 0 terms.
66	1. **Scope — ask on every run.** `node scripts/config/notes.mjs scopes --module <M>` prints activities and batches per scope (activities with reviewed notes from earlier runs are left out). Ask with one `AskUserQuestion`, each option labelled with its numbers from that output and the cost (one batch ≈ 12 activities, a writer, a reviewer and usually a revision run with web research — measured on MM: about 750k tokens and 40 minutes per batch):
67	   - `custom` — activities customer transports changed (Recommended)
68	   - `values` — also standard and empty ones (every activity with a table)
69	   - `all` — every activity, including transaction-only ones
70	   - `none` — no notes this run; the document is built without new notes
71	   Then `node scripts/config/notes.mjs batches --module <M> --scope <scope> --size 12` → `notes/_in/bNNN.json` (numbered after existing batches; `--redo` rewrites reviewed activities too, only when the user asks).
72	2. **Write** — per batch, `Agent(subagent_type: "sc4sap:sap-<m>-consultant")` with prompt § 1 (saves `--kind draft`). Batches run in parallel, at most 4 at a time.
73	3. **Review** — per batch, prompt § 2: (a) `notes-lint.mjs` on the main thread (sources, transactions, counts, check findings — no tokens), (b) `sc4sap:sap-critic` judges SAP meaning with the lint facts in hand and opens only sources the lint marks `new` / `changed` (saves `--kind review`, prints the `fix` list). Saving a review adds the sources of every `ok` activity to the verified-source cache, which later batches receive as `knownSources`; `notes.mjs sources --module <M>` seeds that cache from batches reviewed before it existed.
74	4. **Revise** — for a batch with `fix` items, the writer agent again with prompt § 3 (saves `--kind revised`). One round; findings still open after it stay visible in the document ("Review findings open").
75	5. `node scripts/config/notes.mjs status --module <M>` must show draft + review for every batch of this run before Step 5 (skip this step with scope `none`).
76	6. **Knowledge base.** `node scripts/config/notes.mjs kb --module <M>` copies the general part of every reviewed note (purpose, SAP documentation summary, cases without the verdicts, comparison, checklist, criteria, official sources) to `~/.sc4sap/kb/config/<M>/<lang>/`. Later runs — this system again or any other system — mark those activities `"mode": "system"` in their batches: the writer adds only impact, cautions and one verdict per case, with no web research, and the reviewer checks only that part. On MM this cuts a batch to a fraction of the first-run cost.
77	
78	**Step 5 — Build.**
79	```
80	node scripts/config/build-config-doc.mjs --module <M> [--lang <lang>] [--import <edited.html>]
81	```
82	Output: `<artifactBase>/config-docs/<M>/<M>-config-v<n>-<lang>.html` (`status` counts, checks with findings and `edited` notes in the JSON line). When the user hands back a page saved from edit mode, build with `--import <file>`: its edits merge into `notes/edits.json` (per activity or view the newer edit wins; a page from another system or module is refused) and every later build keeps them — edited views replace their values, card title and history and are drawn again. Edits never enter the knowledge base.
83	
84	**Step 6 — Close.** Report in the user's language:
85	- the file path, IMG activities by status (customized / standard / not set / no values / not readable),
86	- the check findings by severity, error ones by title,
87	- tables that could not be read, and why (blocklist, dispatcher),
88	- one line: the document holds the system's real configuration values — share it internally only.
89	
90	Do not paste table contents into chat.
91	</Workflow>

94	Per IMG activity: IMG path, title (document language + English), status badge, T-codes, consultant notes with their review state, objects (view / view cluster / table), row and customer-row counts; for each view an SM30 overview drawn with the first rows (customer rows first) and, for wide views, a detail screen of one row; the full value table (key columns bold, fixed-value texts next to codes, customer rows highlighted with their transports, filter and "customer rows only"); the customer transports that touched the table (date, request, user, description); checks for the activity; SAP's IMG documentation. Overview: counts by status, areas with status bars, recent customer transports. Right panel: all check findings, click to jump.
95	
96	Edit mode ("Edit" in the top bar, nothing installed): the consultant notes and the reference panel become editable plain text — add or delete list items, add notes to an activity without them, delete a source — and so do the views: card title, value-table cells (rows added or deleted) and the change-history rows. Edited notes and views carry an "Edited · author · date" badge, so readers see where the page differs from the system; an edited view's SM30 drawing is drawn again from the edited rows at the next `--import` build. Any drawing (overview or detail) can be replaced by a real screenshot — "Use screenshot", or click the drawing and Ctrl+V; "Original screen" brings the drawing back; captures wider than 1800 px are scaled down. Undo (Ctrl+Z / button), autosave to the browser with "continue editing" on reopen. "Save" asks for author and change note and downloads the page with every edit embedded (`<script id="config-edits">`) — the file to hand back for `--import`.
97	</Document_Contents>

# SuperClaude for SAP (sc4sap) — Development Rules

This file is the **index** of development rules — NOT a payload to preload. Detailed rules live in `common/` and `exceptions/`. Consult files on demand per [`common/context-loading-protocol.md`](common/context-loading-protocol.md) — 4-tier model: **Tier 1** global mandatory safety baseline (always loaded by every agent: `data-extraction-policy`, `sap-version-reference`, `naming-conventions`; `context-loading-protocol` + `model-routing-rule` are orchestrator-only, read by skills), **Tier 2** role-mandatory per agent group, **Tier 3** triggered reads, **Tier 4** per-task kit. ## Critical Rules (summary — full text in referenced files)

1. **Custom objects use `Z`/`Y` prefix.** Full rules: `common/naming-conventions.md`.
2. **Match SAP version and ABAP release.** Never use S/4-only tables on ECC or syntax newer than the configured `abapRelease`. Full rules: `common/sap-version-reference.md`, `common/abap-release-reference.md`.
3. **Transport discipline.** Every change goes on a transport. Description format: `[MODULE] [Action] [Object] - [brief]`. Never release with syntax errors or inactive objects. Every `CreateTransport` call must receive an explicit `client` parameter resolved from `.sc4sap/sap.env` SAP_CLIENT (full rule: `common/transport-client-rule.md`).
4. **Activate after every change.** Run `GetAbapSemanticAnalysis` for syntax, then `GetInactiveObjects` to confirm no leftovers. Follow Clean ABAP conventions: `common/clean-code.md` (shared) + the paradigm-specific companion (`clean-code-oop.md` OR `clean-code-procedural.md`).
5. **Data extraction is gated.** Before any `GetTableContents` / `GetSqlQuery`: consult `exceptions/table_exception.md` and `common/data-extraction-policy.md`. Schema/DDIC (`GetTable`, `GetStructure`, `GetView`, `GetDataElement`, `GetDomain`) is always allowed.
6. **`acknowledge_risk` requires explicit user affirmative** (`yes` / `승인` / `authorize` / `approve` / `proceed` / `confirmed`). Ambiguous commands (`뽑아봐`, `try it`, `pull it`, `my mistake`) are NOT authorization. Per-call, per-table, per-session — never carries over. Full protocol: `common/data-extraction-policy.md` → "The `acknowledge_risk` Parameter — HARD RULE".
7. **Industry context matters.** For config analysis / business process design / Fit-Gap: load the project's `industry/<key>.md` (from `config.json` → `industry` or `sap.env` → `SAP_INDUSTRY`). If unset, ask the user.
8. **Country / localization context matters.** For tax, e-invoicing, banking, statutory reporting, date/number formats: load the project's `country/<iso>.md` (from `config.json` → `country` or `sap.env` → `SAP_COUNTRY`, ISO alpha-2 lowercase: `kr`, `us`, `de`, `eu-common`, …). Multi-country projects load every relevant file and flag cross-country touchpoints (intercompany, intra-EU VAT, transfer pricing). If unset, ask the user.

# Multi-Profile Artifact Resolution

When multi-profile mode is active (`<project>/.sc4sap/active-profile.txt` exists), project-local artifacts live under `<project>/.sc4sap/work/<alias>/...` instead of directly under `.sc4sap/`. Skills that read or write artifacts **must** use the resolution rules below to stay correct across profile switches.

## Rules

### Write path — always the active profile

```
<project>/.sc4sap/work/{activeAlias}/<category>/<rest>
```

Categories: `program/`, `cbo/`, `customizations/`, `audit/`, `comparisons/`, `processes/`. Writes NEVER fall back to another profile or to the project root.

Legacy (no active-profile.txt): writes go to `<project>/.sc4sap/<category>/<rest>` exactly as before.

### Read path — current profile first, then fall-through (read-only)

1. Look up `<project>/.sc4sap/work/{activeAlias}/<relative>`.
2. If not found, iterate other profiles in `<project>/.sc4sap/work/*/`. Return the first hit, **annotated** with `ℹ from=<otherAlias> (readonly cross-view)`.
3. Legacy fallback: `<project>/.sc4sap/<relative>`.

Cross-view reads let a QA-active session open a Dev-produced spec without copying it. The annotation is important: the skill must NEVER silently write back to a file it found through cross-view — that would corrupt the source profile. Treat cross-view reads as immutable.

## Skill implementation pattern

Before any `Read` of an artifact path, walk the rules above. Pseudocode:

```
function resolveArtifact(relativePath):
  active = readFile('.sc4sap/active-profile.txt')
  if active:
    primary = '.sc4sap/work/' + active + '/' + relativePath
    if exists(primary): return { path: primary, from: active, crossView: false }
    for alias in listDirs('.sc4sap/work/'):
      if alias == active: continue
      candidate = '.sc4sap/work/' + alias + '/' + relativePath
      if exists(candidate): return { path: candidate, from: alias, crossView: true }
  legacy = '.sc4sap/' + relativePath
  if exists(legacy): return { path: legacy, from: null, crossView: false }
  return null
```

For writes:

```
function writePath(relativePath):
  active = readFile('.sc4sap/active-profile.txt')
  if active: return '.sc4sap/work/' + active + '/' + relativePath
  return '.sc4sap/' + relativePath  // legacy
```

## Affected skills

Skills that read or produce project-local artifacts must adopt this pattern:

- `/sc4sap:create-program` — writes `program/<name>/{platform,interview,spec,plan,report,...}.md`
- `/sc4sap:program-to-spec` — reads existing programs, writes spec.md / spec.xlsx
- `/sc4sap:analyze-code` — writes review report
- `/sc4sap:analyze-cbo-obj` — writes `cbo/<MODULE>/<PACKAGE>/{index,inventory}.md`
- `/sc4sap:compare-programs` — writes `comparisons/<NAME>-v<n>-<lang>.html` + `.md` source + `<NAME>-<lang>.history.json` + `_img/` / `_assets/` screen pictures
- `/sc4sap:config-to-document` — writes `config-docs/<MODULE>/<MODULE>-config-v<n>-<lang>.html` + `snapshot.json` + `_cache.json` (read cache) + `notes/` (consultant notes, review)
- `/sc4sap:package-to-process` — reads `cbo/<MODULE>/<PACKAGE>/inventory.json` (cross-view hit → refuse on a `sap_version` mismatch, else ask), writes `processes/<MODULE>/<PACKAGE>/{process-*, bpml-*, _state/}`
- `/sc4sap:program-to-manual` — writes `manuals/<PROGRAM>-v<n>-<lang>.html` + `<PROGRAM>-<lang>.history.json` + `_src/` / `_draft/` manual.json
- `/sc4sap:analyze-symptom` — writes audit reports
- `/sc4sap:create-object` — writes nothing long-term (transient state only)
- Setup / sap-option — manage profile files themselves; outside this pattern

Each affected skill's SKILL.md should explicitly state "uses multi-profile artifact resolution per `common/multi-profile-artifact-resolution.md`" so the LLM picks up the rule at dispatch time.

## Invariants

- **Never** write to `<project>/.sc4sap/` directly when `active-profile.txt` exists — always scope under `work/<alias>/`.
- **Never** write to a cross-view path — cross-view is read-only by definition.
- When surfacing a cross-view read to the user, always show the origin alias. This prevents confusion when QA sees a Dev-authored spec and accidentally edits it with the current-profile context in mind.
- Legacy projects (no active-profile.txt) behave identically to pre-0.6.0 — no breaking change.

1	# Multi-Profile Artifact Resolution
2	
3	When multi-profile mode is active (`<project>/.sc4sap/active-profile.txt` exists), project-local artifacts live under `<project>/.sc4sap/work/<alias>/...` instead of directly under `.sc4sap/`. Skills that read or write artifacts **must** use the resolution rules below to stay correct across profile switches.
4	
5	## Rules
6	
7	### Write path — always the active profile
8	
9	```
10	<project>/.sc4sap/work/{activeAlias}/<category>/<rest>
11	```
12	
13	Categories: `program/`, `cbo/`, `customizations/`, `audit/`, `comparisons/`, `processes/`. Writes NEVER fall back to another profile or to the project root.
14	
15	Legacy (no active-profile.txt): writes go to `<project>/.sc4sap/<category>/<rest>` exactly as before.
16	
17	### Read path — current profile first, then fall-through (read-only)
18	
19	1. Look up `<project>/.sc4sap/work/{activeAlias}/<relative>`.
20	2. If not found, iterate other profiles in `<project>/.sc4sap/work/*/`. Return the first hit, **annotated** with `ℹ from=<otherAlias> (readonly cross-view)`.
21	3. Legacy fallback: `<project>/.sc4sap/<relative>`.
22	
23	Cross-view reads let a QA-active session open a Dev-produced spec without copying it. The annotation is important: the skill must NEVER silently write back to a file it found through cross-view — that would corrupt the source profile. Treat cross-view reads as immutable.
24	
25	## Skill implementation pattern
26	
27	Before any `Read` of an artifact path, walk the rules above. Pseudocode:
28	
29	```
30	function resolveArtifact(relativePath):
31	  active = readFile('.sc4sap/active-profile.txt')
32	  if active:
33	    primary = '.sc4sap/work/' + active + '/' + relativePath
34	    if exists(primary): return { path: primary, from: active, crossView: false }
35	    for alias in listDirs('.sc4sap/work/'):
36	      if alias == active: continue
37	      candidate = '.sc4sap/work/' + alias + '/' + relativePath
38	      if exists(candidate): return { path: candidate, from: alias, crossView: true }
39	  legacy = '.sc4sap/' + relativePath
40	  if exists(legacy): return { path: legacy, from: null, crossView: false }
41	  return null
42	```
43	
44	For writes:
45	
46	```
47	function writePath(relativePath):
48	  active = readFile('.sc4sap/active-profile.txt')
49	  if active: return '.sc4sap/work/' + active + '/' + relativePath
50	  return '.sc4sap/' + relativePath  // legacy
51	```
52	
53	## Affected skills
54	
55	Skills that read or produce project-local artifacts must adopt this pattern:
56	
57	- `/sc4sap:create-program` — writes `program/<name>/{platform,interview,spec,plan,report,...}.md`
58	- `/sc4sap:program-to-spec` — reads existing programs, writes spec.md / spec.xlsx
59	- `/sc4sap:analyze-code` — writes review report
60	- `/sc4sap:analyze-cbo-obj` — writes `cbo/<MODULE>/<PACKAGE>/{index,inventory}.md`
61	- `/sc4sap:compare-programs` — writes `comparisons/<NAME>-v<n>-<lang>.html` + `.md` source + `<NAME>-<lang>.history.json` + `_img/` / `_assets/` screen pictures
62	- `/sc4sap:config-to-document` — writes `config-docs/<MODULE>/<MODULE>-config-v<n>-<lang>.html` + `snapshot.json` + `_cache.json` (read cache) + `notes/` (consultant notes, review)
63	- `/sc4sap:package-to-process` — reads `cbo/<MODULE>/<PACKAGE>/inventory.json` (cross-view hit → refuse on a `sap_version` mismatch, else ask), writes `processes/<MODULE>/<PACKAGE>/{process-*, bpml-*, _state/}`
64	- `/sc4sap:program-to-manual` — writes `manuals/<PROGRAM>-v<n>-<lang>.html` + `<PROGRAM>-<lang>.history.json` + `_src/` / `_draft/` manual.json
65	- `/sc4sap:analyze-symptom` — writes audit reports
66	- `/sc4sap:create-object` — writes nothing long-term (transient state only)
67	- Setup / sap-option — manage profile files themselves; outside this pattern
68	
69	Each affected skill's SKILL.md should explicitly state "uses multi-profile artifact resolution per `common/multi-profile-artifact-resolution.md`" so the LLM picks up the rule at dispatch time.
70	
71	## Invariants
72	
73	- **Never** write to `<project>/.sc4sap/` directly when `active-profile.txt` exists — always scope under `work/<alias>/`.
74	- **Never** write to a cross-view path — cross-view is read-only by definition.
75	- When surfacing a cross-view read to the user, always show the origin alias. This prevents confusion when QA sees a Dev-authored spec and accidentally edits it with the current-profile context in mind.
76	- Legacy projects (no active-profile.txt) behave identically to pre-0.6.0 — no breaking change.
77

설계 초안을 정리했습니다. 기존 결정 1–10은 그대로 반영했고, 새로 생긴 쟁점만 묻겠습니다.

## 설계 초안: `/sc4sap:interface-mapping-spec`

**구조** (config-to-document과 같은 방식: JSON 모델 → 빌드 스크립트 → 편집 가능한 HTML 1개)
- `scripts/interface/build-if-spec.mjs`는 모델 JSON을 페이지로 만들고, `--import`로 편집본을 병합합니다.
- `scripts/interface/if-spec-page.mjs`는 화면 렌더링, `if-spec-editor.mjs`는 편집 모드를 맡습니다. 편집 모드는 config-doc-editor 패턴을 그대로 씁니다: plain text, 셀과 행 추가·삭제, 실행 취소, IndexedDB 임시 저장, Save 시 `<script id="if-edits">` 내장.
- `scripts/interface/sap-fields.mjs`는 MCP로 DDIC 구조·테이블과 FM 시그니처를 읽어 SAP 측 필드 행을 만듭니다.
- 산출물은 `<artifactBase>/interfaces/<IF_ID>/<IF_ID>-v0.1-ko.html`, `-en.html`, `model.json`, `history.json`입니다.

**페이지 (한 페이지, 섹션 4개)**
1. 표지: 프로젝트명, 문서번호 패턴, 버전, 저작권 문구. 모두 설정값입니다.
2. 개정이력: Save/import 때마다 한 줄씩 자동으로 추가됩니다.
3. 매핑 정의서: 헤더 블록, Request 그리드(A01…), 선택형 Response 그리드(B01…, 동기일 때만), 변환규칙 R1…, 추출조건 SQL, 특이사항, 기타. 코드 목록 항목은 드롭다운으로 둡니다.
4. 항목설명: 각 라벨의 ⓘ 툴팁과 맨 끝 참고 섹션으로 들어갑니다.

**검증 패널** (결정 10): 비어 있는 `*` 필수 항목, MAPPING 번호가 Source 행에 없는 경우, R id가 규칙 목록에 없는 경우를 표시합니다.

**워크플로**
1. IF ID, IF 명, SAP가 어느 쪽인지(Source / Target / 양쪽), SAP 객체를 입력받습니다.
2. MCP로 SAP 측을 자동으로 채웁니다.
3. 헤더 항목은 코드 목록 선택지로 인터뷰합니다.
4. 빌드한 뒤 영문 페이지를 만들고, 경로를 보고합니다.

템플릿 예시를 보다가 발견한 점이 있습니다. `FICTR CHAR 16 → VARCHAR2 8`처럼 **잘림이 생기는 매핑**이 실제로 들어 있었습니다. 이 때문에 검증을 넓히는 것도 질문에 넣었습니다.

options.label: DDIC 그대로 (Recommended)
options.description: CHAR/NUMC/DATS/CURR/DEC 등 + 길이(소수점). SAP 측 드롭다운에 ABAP 타입 추가. Null은 키필드=N, 나머지 공란

# Handoff — new skill: interface mapping spec (2026-10-15)

Start a fresh session with: "HANDOFF_2026-10-15_interface-mapping-spec.md 읽고 이어서 진행해줘".

## Goal (user's words, summarised)

A new sc4sap skill that asks the user a few questions and produces an **interface mapping specification** as an **editable HTML** page laid out like the user's Excel template. Editable-HTML behaviour should follow the existing skills (`program-to-manual`, `program-to-spec`, `config-to-document`). **The user wants to be asked** about open points and improvements — even small ones — before they are built.

## Template (reference only — local, customer file)

`C:\보관용\업무\한국타이어\기타\EAI_3030_매핑_정의서_CO00180_FUND CENTER 정보 송신_v0.1_20190625_암해.xlsx`

- Full dump (every cell, merges, validations, comments): `_handoff/interface-mapping-spec/dump.txt`; reader script `_handoff/interface-mapping-spec/read-xlsx.mjs <unzipped xlsx dir>` (unzip a *copy*: Copy-Item → .zip → Expand-Archive in the scratchpad).
- It is a real customer document (customer project name, vendor copyright, real people's names). The skill and anything public (repo, CHANGELOG, README) must stay generic: no customer / vendor names, no people. See memory `feedback_no_company_initials_in_docs`, `feedback_no_customer_specifics_in_changelog`.

### Sheets

1. **표지 (cover)** — project name, document title "인터페이스 매핑 정의서", document number `EAI-3030-인터페이스-매핑-정의서-<IF ID>`, "(<IF name>)", version, copyright lines (make all configurable).
2. **개정이력 (revision history)** — 순번 / 버전 / 변경 일자 / 변경 내용 / 작성자 / 승인자; note "변경이 발생되는 위치와 변경 내용을 자세히 기록".
3. **매핑 정의서 (mapping spec)** — 17 columns A–Q; `*` = required.
   - Header block: *인터페이스 ID, *인터페이스 명, *인터페이스 개요, 인터페이스 상세 설명, 전송방식 | *인터페이스 구동방식, *인터페이스 주기 | 인터페이스 주기 별 회수, 1회 전송 건수 | 건당 데이터 크기, 송/수신 시스템 관계 | *Target 기본 로직, *매핑 정의서 작성자 | *매핑 정의서 작성일.
   - Request block "Source System → Target System": per side *시스템 명, *모듈 명 (SAP: required), *지역, *시스템 담당자, *I/F Methods (Adapter), *Object, *Structure, *필수(반복) 구분; then the field grid: No (A01…) | Table | *Field | *Key | *Type | *Size | *Null | *Desc | **R** (conversion-rule id) | Table | *Field | *Key | *Type | *Size | *Null | **MAPPING** (source No) | *Desc.
   - Response block "Source ← Target" (sync return, B01…): same grid (example XSTAT / XMSGS).
   - Footer: 컬럼별 변환규칙 (R1, R2, …), 데이터 추출조건 (I/F query — select / update SQL), 특이사항, 기타.
   - Note in the sheet: one-way async interfaces go to a "비동기_케이스" tab (not present in this file).
4. **매핑 정의서 항목설명 (field guide)** — every item with required flag and explanation (good source for in-page help / tooltips).

### Code lists (dropdowns, from an external 공통코드 sheet; cached values)

- 지역: 한국, 구주, 미주, 아태, 인니, 중국, 헝가리, G.PI
- 구동방식: PUSH, PULL
- 주기: 년, 월, 주, 일, 시, 분, 초, 실시간, 수시(수동), 기타
- 데이터 타입: CHAR, NCHAR, VARCHAR, VARCHAR2, NVARCHAR2, NUMBER, FLOAT, INTEGER, LONG, DATE, TIMESTAMP, RAW, LONG RAW, BLOB, CLOB, NCLOB, BFILE
- 여부: Y, N
- 송수신 관계: 1:1, 1:N, N:1
- 필수(반복): 0:1, 0:N, 1:1, 1:N
- Structure: PARAMETER, STRUCTURE, TABLE
- 전송방식: 동기(Syncronous), 비동기(Asyncronous), 비동기 콜백(Asyncronous Call Back)
- Adapter: JDBC (Oracle), JDBC (MS-SQL), JDBC (Sybase), JDBC (DB2), ABAP Proxy, 웹서비스 (SOAP), FTP, SFTP, RFC, DB LINK, ETC

## Building blocks to reuse (read before designing)

- Editable pages: `scripts/manual/manual-editor.mjs` (Quill bubble, screenshots, undo, IndexedDB draft, Save → embedded source, `build-manual.mjs --import`), `scripts/spec/spec-editor.mjs` + `md-to-html.mjs --editable` + `html-to-md.mjs` + `spec-version.mjs` (versioned specs, history.json), `scripts/config/config-doc-editor.mjs` (plain-text fields, table cells/rows, `data-ef`/`data-ve` attributes, edits JSON in `<script id="config-edits">`, `--import` merge with newer-wins).
- Excel output exists: `scripts/spec/md-to-xlsx.mjs` (compare-programs).
- SAP side (optional auto-fill): MCP `GetStructure` / `GetTable` / `GetFunctionModule` / `GetDataElement` for SAP field names, types, lengths, descriptions of the source/target object (ABAP Proxy structure, RFC, Z table).
- Artifact paths: `common/multi-profile-artifact-resolution.md` (new category folder under the profile artifact base).

## Rules to keep

- Skill / agent MD ≤ 200 lines, English only (`feedback_md_line_limit`, `feedback_skill_md_language`); Agent dispatches use `sc4sap:sap-<name>`.
- Editable fields: plain text through `esc()`; table cells stay table cells (bug fixed in 0.6.37: no `display:block` on `td.ed`); undo, draft, save, import as in config-doc-editor.
- Release flow: tests (`npx vitest run`), tsc, version bump in package.json + plugin.json + marketplace.json (×2), CHANGELOG, commit on `active` with Entire trailer (`entire attach <session>` → `Entire-Checkpoint:`), push, merge to `main`, CI, 3-location sync (marketplace clone + cache `installPath`). `main` push currently bypasses a "PR required" rule — ask the user whether to keep doing that.
